exit_attribution.root_cause: Frozen external close origin/kind was not mapped by the ordinary review; the mover reader had an independent projection and whitelist.
exit_attribution.meaning: Reconciled external reduction; the trigger is still unknown. Not proof of manual close, stop-loss or liquidation.
exit_attribution.chronology_fix: Select actual latest eligible CLOSE fill, not latest order updated_at; earlier partial exits cannot overwrite the final cause.
exit_attribution.projection_safety: Unknown origin remains unknown; liquidation requires explicit Binance external origin plus LIQUIDATION kind; no current exit state substituted.

initial.reason: New PG fixture supplied 9 parameters for 8 placeholders; fixed test wrapper replaced its final evidence argument rather than appending one.

qa.scope: Selected review, immutable-label, daily account/mover and exit-policy regressions using disposable PG and blocked venue networking; not whole repository or LIVE execution acceptance.

independent_review.method: Read-only review of final frozen code, source/test hashes and final PG log.
independent_review.verified: Negative-only decision authority, exact fixed binding/policy identity, transaction-held state locks, live lease, atomic evidence/decision/receipt, budget/drain checks and unchanged fresh-risk path for non-veto results.
coverage_limitations: Dedicated restricted-role and individual pre-existing receipt/orphan-intent test variants were not added in this patch.
Selected isolated regression success is not whole-repository, all-permissions or live-venue acceptance.
No claim of strategy-profitability improvement or complete resolution of every signal-latency cause.

unchanged_runtime_observation.interpretation: Process identity unchanged; this is not end-to-end trading-health evidence.

jev_followup.cause: Successful model veto requires a redundant full signed account-context reacquisition before rejection; admission GET quota can expire the fixed 30-second review binding.
jev_followup.fix: PG-only verified terminal VETO before account GETs, both after same-cycle wake and on a pending-task continuation. Approved/fallback/uncertain candidates retain fresh risk/account rechecks.

historical_candidate_review.interpretation: Candidate outcomes, not settled-trade counts. Historic threshold comparison does not prove 92 recoverable decisions or profitable missed entries. Three model passes do not prove other risk checks would pass.

boundaries: No fabricated OPEN or reused account/risk admission proof; terminal decision is IGNORED only.
Exact account/source/signal/config/model request/direction/hash identity, bound policy versions and unexpired signal/model/review deadlines required.
Production ACCOUNT_PG shortcut requires a present, locked current runtime-policy row matching worker version/digest/values.
Completed model result, binding, gate policy and model control are checked under transaction-held locks; uncertainty falls back to the existing path.
Existing decision/receipt/intent wins; matching live task lease required; evidence/decision/receipt commit atomically and use the common token-guarded ACK.
PG statement/lock limits and scheduler budget/drain checks prevent optional rejection checks from adding unbudgeted account GETs.
Legacy bindings without model_control_version intentionally retain the normal path; no retrospective re-decisions or edits to historical receipts.
No increase to Binance admission budget, JEV token budget, signal TTL or model deadline. No production role grants.

qa.scope: Selected JEV, strategy scheduling, ready queue, context isolation and admission-budget regressions on disposable PostgreSQL; not whole repository or live-venue acceptance.
